trigger_condition: A client method name is computed rather than an identifier or literal bracket member
potential_consequence: Known-member inventory misses the call; resource enforcement can allow an otherwise empty scan

trigger_condition: An rpc/from method is extracted or bound then invoked through another variable
potential_consequence: The eventual alias invocation has no recognizable rpc/from member and escapes inventory

trigger_condition: A quoted code example or inline block comment contains legacy database-call syntax
potential_consequence: Retained regex count gate blocks nonexecuting examples despite correct AST resource inventory
